articleTitle: Role of the additive of oxygen at plasma etching of silicon
publicationTitle: Proceedings, 6th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: Research concerning the process of plasma etching of silicon in a CF/sub 2/Cl/sub 2//O/sub 2/ plasma using "Plasma-600" equipment is carried out. The shift of the maximum dependence of etching rate in the direction of greater O/sub 2/ content in an initial mix for a CF/sub 2/Cl/sub 2//O/sub 2/ chemistry in comparison with CF/sub 4//O/sub 2/ and SF/sub 6//O/sub 2/ plasmas.

articleTitle: Measuring devices with a self-adapting adaptive system of automatic control
publicationTitle: Proceedings, 6th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: At a modification of the operation conditions of systems of a phase synchronization (PSS) femtosecond UHF and the MICROWAVE of ranges over a wide range, happens as a modification of a signal on an exit of plant of control, and arises uncertainty of parameters of blocks of a control system, the action of exterior parasites is exhibited. The state-of-the-art of researches in the field of a construction of the governors of adaptive systems of automatic control gives an occasion to search on their basis for modes and algorithms of a construction PSS. It will allow supplying as high reliability of work of systems of shaping of electrical signals and exactitude of maintaining of their parameters, and specific dynamic and static performances of systems of synchronization.

articleTitle: Analysis of experimental and numerical calculations results on microwave irradiator for reflexotherapy
publicationTitle: Proceedings, 6th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: Experimental results as well as calculations on the microwave irradiator for reflexotherapy made of piece of coaxial waveguide are discussed. The calculations for the frequency of 915 MHz are made by finite elements method. It is shown that the calculations results are close to experimental results.

articleTitle: Some fundamental principles of the FZP-like antenna developments
publicationTitle: Proceedings, 6th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: Two different microwave working groups in Russia and Spain, having a large distance between them, have stabilised contact via Email, beginning an interchange of ideas with a common nexus: the Fresnel diffraction theory applied to microwave and mm-wave antennas. The intention of this paper is to present a review of some new fundamental principles of developments and applications, those having been realised by both groups.

articleTitle: Ultrasonic insonator for reflexotherapy
publicationTitle: Proceedings, 6th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: Ultrasonic insonator (USI) consisting of piezoceramic plate with rigidly connected steel rod is considered. A method for acoustic signal intensity calculation is proposed. Calculated intensities are closed to experimentally measured intensities. It is shown that the insonator generates maximal signal at resonant frequencies and that the number of peaks in frequency dependence decreases when the length of the rod is decreased and it should be taken into account when designing new devices for reflexotherapy.

articleTitle: Synthesis of astatic multivariable systems by the localization method
publicationTitle: Proceedings, 6th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: A method for synthesizing automatic control systems of multivariable time-varying nonlinear objects with higher derivative control and an integral controller providing high dynamic accuracy and low sensitivity of the systems to parameter variations and external disturbances has been considered.

articleTitle: Method of definition of the contributions of customers and mains in change of a voltage quality
publicationTitle: Proceedings, 6th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: The description of a method of definition of customers individual shares and mains in change of a voltage quality is given.

articleTitle: Applying the sliding mode in automatic search extreme system
publicationTitle: Proceedings, 6th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: This paper presents the possibility of applying the sliding mode method for synthesis of the automatic search extreme system. Is shown, the use of the output characteristic gradient estimation allows to transform the plant and to reduce an initial synthesis problem to the usual stabilization task. The basic properties of the closed-loop extreme system are considered. Some recommendations for physical realization of the control law are given.

articleTitle: Spirometabolic complex design
publicationTitle: Proceedings, 6th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: The problems of calorimetry is discussed, the requirements to apparatus maintenance are formulated. The basic reasons influencing accuracy of measurement in rest energy expenditure are revealed and are overcome. The structure and parameters of developed spirometabolic complex are given.

articleTitle: Adaptive robust signal detection algorithms
publicationTitle: Proceedings, 6th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: The adaptive, asymptotically robust algorithms developed permit signal detection in independent noise of arbitrary form. The algorithms demonstrate high efficiency in the cases of heavy tail distribution, where conventional algorithms are usually characterized by low noise immunity.

articleTitle: Designing low signal transistor amplifiers by criterion of minimum of technological losses on the basis of the equivalent circuit of transistor
publicationTitle: Proceedings, 6th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: The purpose of the submitted work is the description of the mathematical model, allowing to optimize technological losses of manufacture of serial products of low signal transistor amplifiers (LTA) and also to discuss the results of the carried out researches for transistor KT372A.

articleTitle: Diffraction properties of photopolymerized liquid-crystal composites
publicationTitle: Proceedings, 6th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: Experimental samples of polymer-dispersed liquid crystals (PDLC) of uniform and periodic spatial structure have been obtained and studied. The characteristic sizes of PDLC droplets and the refraction-index modulation range have been estimated by analyzing the texture of these samples and the diffracted-light intensity.

articleTitle: Research of influence of weight's coefficient of criterion's on linear automatic control systems under effect of casual measurement noise
publicationTitle: Proceedings, 6th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: The problem of the definition of the influence of weight coefficient of criterion of a minimum of a root-mean-square error on the resultant error of a linear system is discussed. This error is used for the definition of small parameters of a system and is determined by the dispersion caused by measurement noise and by error of reproduction of the determined reference input.

articleTitle: Data transmission protocol based on modified ARQ-SR algorithm with partial error correction
publicationTitle: Proceedings, 6th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: The important step in development of almost all systems of communication is the design and practical implementation of the data transmission protocol. It is worth saying that peculiarities of modified automatic repeat request with selective repeat (MARQ-SR) algorithm, which was proposed earlier by the author for increasing ARQ-SR algorithm throughput, have a significant effect on data transfer protocol. This paper presents the data transmission protocol for the mentioned above algorithm implementation. The possible applications are stated as well.

articleTitle: Estimation of technological losses of manufacture of the serial products of low signal transistor amplifiers realized on criterion of the bilateral matching
publicationTitle: Proceedings, 6th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: The results of researches of low. signal transistor amplifiers realized by criterion of bilateral matching in view of constructive-technological scatters are discussed.

articleTitle: The phenomenon of formation of an acoustic field in the lumens of microvessels of the blood circulation system
publicationTitle: Proceedings, 6th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: In this paper experimental results of investigations of the physical mechanism of transcapillary exchange by the method of phase sensitive laser spectroscopy of light scattering are presented. Acoustic oscillations of the walls of microvessels (arterioles, capillaries, and venules) which provide transcapillary exchange have been detected for the first time.

articleTitle: The estimation of technological losses of serial production of the serial articles of transistor amplifiers
publicationTitle: Proceedings, 6th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: The mathematical model for estimation of technological losses of production of serial articles of transistor amplifiers is discussed.

articleTitle: About refraction in the nonlinear theory of injection lasers; modelling of experiment
publicationTitle: Proceedings, 6th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: The equations for intensity in injection semiconductor lasers are deduced with account for dependence of factor of refraction and factor of losses on density of energy, that allows to explain and to simulate experimental data.

articleTitle: All solid state lasers for photodynamic therapy of the malignant neoplasms
publicationTitle: Proceedings, 6th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: The work demonstrate possibility of the treatment of animals with malignant neoplasms using 608 nm laser radiation by means photodynamic therapy (PDT). The intracavity transformation of the Nd:YAP main radiation 1079 nm was Raman converted in barium nitrate crystal and Stokes frequency (1216 nm) was doubled using KTP or RTP crystals. The LiF or Cr:YAG crystals are used for the Q-switch. The radiation parameters were obtained at a pump repetition frequency 100 Hz. The average power at 608 nm radiation with LiF and KTP was 700 mW at multimode generation. The 3-6 single 10-15 ns pulses was generated during one cycle of pumping. The doubling efficiency with RTP was two times more than with KTP. The cells of Ehrlich adenocarcinoma (0.1 ml) were implanted in hind thighs of ICR white non-imbred mice. Photosensitizer HPD was i.v. administered in a dose of 10 mg/kg. Ten animals were treated (2 as a control). There was 9-30% decrease in the tumor growth depending on the irradiation dose. The better result (30%) was for the 200 J/cm/sup 2/ dose radiation. These results show the possibility of using PDT with all solid state laser with wavelength 608 nm.

articleTitle: Hypothesis testing in fuzzy regression analysis
publicationTitle: Proceedings, 6th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: When input data in regression analysis are fuzzy numbers for estimating parameters fuzzy least squares method is used. For linear hypothesis testing a statistics based on ratio of residual sums of squares is proposed and its distribution is derived.

articleTitle: Irregular pixel defects in hybrid IR-sensitive integrated circuits and their effect on results of measurements in medicine and multichannel spectrometry
publicationTitle: Proceedings, 6th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: Distinctive features of effects of irregular pixel defects arisen in lineand 2D-array multielement photodetecting devices designed on the base of hybrid integrated circuits of "sandwich" type are investigated. The experimental results are presented for the photosensitive structures consisted of indium-arsenide and silicon chips. Possibility to solve properly IR-thermographic and spectrometric problems with use of detectors containing pixel defects is considered.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Cure aspects of electronic device "EMAT-express 01" applying for the research of the Oriental medicine PSC phenomenon
publicationTitle: Proceedings, 6th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: The automated device for measurement thermal factors of anisotropic polymers
publicationTitle: Proceedings, 6th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: The author discusses the development of a fast method and the creation of a device for the definition of thermal physical factors of anisotropic polymer composite materials at room temperature. Obtaining the necessary parameters of the material is achieved by a special arrangement of sufficient thermal sensors, which are placed on the sample surface. The information concerning the overheating of a sample is digitized and transferred to a computer for the further processing.

articleTitle: The device for measurement of intensity of an electrical field and degree of its heterogeneity
publicationTitle: Proceedings, 6th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: The device for measurement of intensity of an electrical field and degree of its heterogeneity is offered. In a basis of the device the double one-coordinate electroinduction spherical gauge with two sensitive elements in the form of a spherical layer with external /spl theta/1=90/spl deg/ and internal /spl theta/2=70/spl deg/ by the angular sizes is taken. The differential signal of the gauge is proportional to intensity, and relation of a total of a signal to differential - degree of its heterogeneity.

articleTitle: Scattering parameters measurement using magnitude and homodyne probe signals detecting
publicationTitle: Proceedings, 6th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: The report offers an account of actual principles of operation of the microwave vector network analyzers. A new approach to increasing analyzer dynamic range based on probe signals magnitude detecting is presented taking into consideration feed mismatching. A new effective approach to microwave network parameters measurement is proposed, which combines the methods of magnitude and homodyne detecting.

articleTitle: Installed power of a transformer-based phase converter
publicationTitle: Proceedings, 6th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: A design technique for determination of installed power of a transformer-based phase converter is stated. Using this technique installed powers of transformer windings connected in open circuit and in closed circuit are compared.

articleTitle: Syntheses of effective techniques of complex testing of technical products
publicationTitle: Proceedings, 6th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: The offered method allows one to define the requirements for testing measurement accuracy and optimize the cost of testing of complex electronic devices and with it to provide the required reliability of the testing results.

articleTitle: On the cooperation between APEIE and IEEE in the period 1996-2002
publicationTitle: Proceedings, 6th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: Appropriate Professional Groups have been formed by the local Chapter which consists now of about 80 members. Permanently being in touch with local professionals we have understood that there exists a good potential for increasing number of IEEE members in West Siberia. As a result the Novosibirsk Chapter has been recently extended towards Solid-State Circuits Society. New LEO-S Chapter has been launched as well as ED Student Branch. A new Chapter was launched in Tomsk last year. It is especially worth pointing out that involvement of IEEE in organization and help in conducting the Conference is constantly growing.

IEEE Keywords: Components, Packaging, and Manufacturing Technology Society

articleTitle: Choice of discrete adaptive regulator parameters
publicationTitle: Proceedings, 6th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: The problem of adaptive stabilization for a single-channel plant with parametric uncertainty is discussed. Investigation results of discrete adaptive system stability and the quality of output processes are given.

articleTitle: The stand for magnetostrictive displacement transducers investigation
publicationTitle: Proceedings, 6th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: The ultrasonic magnetostrictive linear displacement transducers are very perspective instruments for measuring of linear qualities (the linear displacement, the liquid level, etc.) in hard working conditions today. The stand was designed and made for investigations of metrological characteristics of magnetostrictive displacement transducers. The purpose and the construction of designed stand and the investigation carried out with the help of stand are presented.

articleTitle: Thresholding of images by Shannon's criterion
publicationTitle: Proceedings, 6th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: Binary classification of images with the minimum information loss is considered. A digital algorithm for printed texts and an experimental method estimating of recognizing quality is proposed.. Some examples are given.

articleTitle: Electron transport features in two-barrier resonant-tunneling Si/CaF/sub 2/ structures
publicationTitle: Proceedings, 6th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: Along with superlattices an engineering and practical use of double-barrier resonant-tunneling Si/CaF/sub 2/ structures is possible. The current-voltage characteristic (CVC) of such structures can have a specific features caused by several mechanisms of electron transport. In this paper we analyse some features of electron transport and CVC of double-barrier resonant-tunneling Si/CaF/sub 2/ structures.

articleTitle: The approached complex function of dispersion of a sound from rough surfaces
publicationTitle: Proceedings, 6th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: A method of accounting for the complex factor of dispersion of a sound wave from rough surfaces is offered. Some settlement diagrams of the complex function of reflection are submitted. The results of research can be used in hydrolocation for an estimation of the form of a reflecting surface.

articleTitle: Anomalous thermomagnetic effect in semiconductor, heterojunctions induced by asymmetrical piezoelectric electron-phonon interaction
publicationTitle: Proceedings, 6th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: A theory of the anomalous thermomagnetic effect in GaAs/AlGaAs heterostructures is created for the case of piezoelectric interaction between electrons and phonons. The theory describes the effect for sub-helium temperatures when the interaction is dominant in such heterostructures.

articleTitle: High-current low-energy electronogens with a outlet of beams through gas-dynamics windows
publicationTitle: Proceedings, 6th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: The circuit of build-up of a high-current electronic radiant with an accelerating voltage up to 100 kV of microsecond duration is considered on a base vacuum-arc discharge with an outlet of beams in an atmosphere through multiway gas-dynamic window.

articleTitle: A mathematical model of routing in B-ISDN with ATM technology
publicationTitle: Proceedings, 6th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: The paper presents a mathematical model of routing in broadband integrated services digital network (B-ISDN) with technology of asynchronous transfer mode (ATM). The model allows inclusion of the following parameters: topology of a B-ISDN with ATM technology; input traffic parameters from different services of electrical communications; features of ATM technology; features of routing. The mathematical model allows one to evaluate quality of service a B-ISDN.

articleTitle: Technique of diagnostics of the technical condition of telecommunication switching system under fuzzy conditions
publicationTitle: Proceedings, 6th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: The technique of technical diagnostics of switching system of a telecommunication network in conditions of incompleteness of the information caused by high complexity of object of diagnostics and deficiency of time of diagnosing is considered. The offered technique is based on concepts of the theory of fuzzy sets. Decisions on a condition of object of diagnostics is accepted on the basis of calculation procedures of fuzzy matrices of preference and double fuzzy integral.

articleTitle: Automation of mass-spectrometer of researches for studying the bakeout of the microchannel plate of image intensifier
publicationTitle: Proceedings, 6th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: The results of development of the automated system of registration and processing of mass-spectrometer information are presented. The device of interface PC with residual gas analyzer (RGA), algorithms of the software for registration of spectra, recognition and processing of mass-spectra are described. The data about the bakeout of elements of image intensifier are received.

articleTitle: Account of inductance of strip conductors
publicationTitle: Proceedings, 6th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: The method of account of inductance of strip conductors without restriction on parity of the linear sizes of conductor is developed. The offered method is based on representation of a common current in a conductor by current strips. This approach provides higher accuracy in comparison with known methods for linear contours. The received results can be used for account of various strip and microstrip devices.

articleTitle: Mathematical-model of an active four-pole for a functional amplifying module with shunt feed-back
publicationTitle: Proceedings, 6th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: Describes a model of an active four-pole for a functional amplifying model utilizing necessary frequency response, reflection coefficient and the structure of a shunt feed-back (FB) four-pole.

articleTitle: High-resolution light scattering spectroscopy in investigations of dynamic properties of water
publicationTitle: Proceedings, 6th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: New results of investigations of the structural self-organization of water in various time and space scales obtained with the help of the high-precision light scattering I laser spectroscopy developed by the authors are presented.

articleTitle: Reflected signal influence on efficiency and power of oscillations in magnetron
publicationTitle: Proceedings, 6th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: Approximated theoretical study and experimental investigation of the influence of reflections on power and efficiency of a magnetron generation are presented. It is shown, that there is a range of the reflected signal phase values for certain detuning parameter values where the value of generation power reduces and the opportunity of multifrequency oscillations appears.

articleTitle: About inter-mode stimulated transition coefficients
publicationTitle: Proceedings, 6th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: Inter-mode stimulated transition coefficients for system with relaxation are derived. The mechanism of the stimulated transition described with the help of inter-mode coefficients can be used for an explanation of experimental supervision connected to interaction of modes.

articleTitle: The complications of laser skin resurfacing
publicationTitle: Proceedings, 6th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: Among laser peeling complications that are observed are herpes infection recidivs. An investigations of the immune systems of operative patients showed immune-deficiency conditions, which resulted in infection complications. It is suggested that one takes into account a patient's anamnesis during the definition of the results of laser resurfacing.

articleTitle: Use of Internets - technologies for dynamic stochastic models identification
publicationTitle: Proceedings, 6th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: In the report the program complex allowing to carry out identification of dynamic autoregressive models with moving average, determined input signal and trend (ARMAX-model) is considered. The program complex allows to estimate parameters of model, decides a task of a choice of an input signal raising quality estimation of parameters. For convenience of the user the transfer of the data is carried out with use the Internet.

articleTitle: Structure identification of linear discrete dynamic models on the basis of check of statistical hypotheses
publicationTitle: Proceedings, 6th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: The review of modern condition of the problem of structure identification of linear discrete dynamic models in the form of linear inhomogeneous difference equation circumscribing discrete dynamic objects and statistical models autoregressive-moving average on the basis of check of statistical hypotheses is submitted.

articleTitle: Modeling of adaptive regulators in systems of phase synchronization
publicationTitle: Proceedings, 6th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: The modern condition of researches in the field of construction of regulators of adaptive systems of automatic control gives the basis to search on their basis for ways and algorithms of construction of systems of phase synchronization femtosecond UHF and MICROWAVE of ranges. Such decision allows to ensure (supply) as high reliability of job of systems of formation of electrical signals and accuracy of maintenance of parameters of signals, and given dynamic and static characteristics of systems of synchronization. It is important for systems working at change of external conditions and parameters of subsystems, blocks and units.

articleTitle: Distortion of characteristic function argument in the process of linear FM signal forming
publicationTitle: Proceedings, 6th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: The present work analyzes the measurement errors of characteristic function real and imaginary parts evaluations, which occur due to not precise determination of the function real parameter in the process of linear FM signal forming.

articleTitle: Filtration of signals at time-and-frequency measurements
publicationTitle: Proceedings, 6th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: The algorithms providing increase of accuracy and a noise stability of measurement of time-and-frequency parameters of signals are given. The filtration of signals is investigated on the basis of wavelet-transformations.

articleTitle: The starter-generating installation based on IGBT - inverters
publicationTitle: Proceedings, 6th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: The starter-generating installation based on voltage source inverters for the gas pump stations and wind power installation is described, the electromagnetic processes are considered and the analytical ratio for the convertible mode of operations of the voltage source inverter are given. The results of the theory are checked up by modeling on the computer with program PARUS.

articleTitle: Researching horn antenna properties in multifrequency measurements
publicationTitle: Proceedings, 6th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: The report summarises the results of researching properties of horn antennas included in a multifrequency microwave reflectometer within frequency range 8-26 GHz and gives the estimation of their fitness as a probe. For a microwave reflectometer, the key is fact of using the antenna at the same time for irradiation of tested structure and reception of reflected signal.

articleTitle: The new methods automated photoelectric spectral analysis with use the standard samples and virtual standards
publicationTitle: Proceedings, 6th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: The essential deficiency of traditional methods of spectral analysis, founded on building of calibration graphs on kits for state standard samples (SSS), is the impossibility of the determination of inaccuracy and validity obtained separately results when undertaking current production analyses. As a rule, the degree of accuracy of spectral methods is realized only for industrial laboratories. Herewith the main attention is paid to the definition of accuracy and convergence of results for existing types of material by way of frequent repetitions of cycles from ten and more measurements.

articleTitle: Aggregation of independent inverters
publicationTitle: Proceedings, 6th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: The problem of aggregation of inverter modules is described. The index of aggregation degree is introduced. The estimation of values of this index for the main classes of inverters is made.

articleTitle: Low voltage commissioning of the system-tie converter Muldenstein/Nuernberg
publicationTitle: Proceedings, 6th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: For providing the railway power supply in some European countries with 15 kV and about 16.7 Hz, static system-tie frequency converters are used since several years. In commissioning the prototype of such a plant, a high risks of damage is apparent as a lot of new components in power devices and control circuits are to be put into operation. This paper describes the procedure of a special low-voltage commissioning avoiding the risk of damage to the power section as only limited voltage (some percent of rated voltage) and limited currents are used up to full control of the system.

articleTitle: Optimization of pulse shaping and pre-equalization in cable transmission systems
publicationTitle: Proceedings, 6th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: In this paper, pulse shaping and pre-equalization in both baseband and multicarrier systems for the data transmission over symmetrical twisted pair lines are analyzed. A worst case signal-to-noise ratio is used as a quality parameter for rating the performance of the various transmission techniques. Especially the pre-equalization results in a noticeable improvement of the transmission quality.

articleTitle: Movable micromechanical joints for use in micromechatronics
publicationTitle: Proceedings, 6th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: This paper deals with single-crystal silicon as a structural material. Its material properties are compared to those of other materials conventionally used for mechanical applications. The advantages; of silicon, e.g. no creep fatigue, are depicted and the most popular micromechanical techniques are named and explained. It is shown how compliant structures made from single-crystal silicon structured by wet chemical etching can be used for applications like flexible guides which allow deflections within the millimetre-range (scaling up). On the other hand, conventional principles of operation know from precision engineering can be shrunken to micromechanical dimensions. As an example, a step-by-step switchgear made by using the Silicon-On-Insulator (SOI) technology is presented.

articleTitle: Design of a low complexity video encoder for non-streaming video applications
publicationTitle: Proceedings, 6th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: This paper proposes the design of a MPEG/H.26x based video encoder with significantly lower computational complexity than common video encoders require. The encoder design is well suited for video applications in a mobile environment, e.g. for MMS based video applications. In order to decrease the complexity, the structure of a standard encoder is divided into a real-time and a non-real-time based part. Furthermore, two simplified interframe processing approaches are proposed and compared in this paper.

articleTitle: Algorithm of decentralized secondary processing radar information
publicationTitle: Proceedings, 6th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: An algorithm of decentralized secondary processing radar information was synthesized in the multiposition radar complex. Filtration of circuit coordinate estimation takes place in some separated receiving places. In the information processing station after classification of the received estimation, the last predicted estimation is formed.

articleTitle: A simple technique for the simulation of capacitive pressure transducers
publicationTitle: Proceedings, 6th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: This paper presents a simple technique which is capable of representing the relationship between diaphragm deflection and capacitance change with pressure in closed form expression for square clamped-edge thin silicon diaphragm capacitive pressure transducer.

articleTitle: Determination of carrier concentration and mobility in two-dimensional semiconductor systems and thin films using Shubnikov-de Haas and cyclotron resonance effects
publicationTitle: Proceedings, 6th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: A new contactless microwave method to measure and calculate the transport parameters of semiconductor two-dimensional (2D) systems such as GaAs/Al/sub x/Ga/sub 1-x/As heterostructures and thin films such as Cd/sub x/Hg/sub 1-x/Te by using Shubnikov-de Haas and cyclotron resonance effects are presented. The relative measurements of the magnetic field dependences of the derivative of the reflection coefficient allows the carrier concentration, Hall-conductivity, carrier mobility and impulse relaxation time to be determined. A contactless test of 2D systems is proposed.

articleTitle: Adaptive filtration of radar signals under conditions of inhomogeneous clutter samples
publicationTitle: Proceedings, 6th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: The questions concerning the design and the features of adaptive rejection filters for the extraction of radar signals against a clutter background with inhomogeneous correlation parameters samples are considered. The many channel on window for averaging parameters adaptive rejection filter (MARF) with a channel selection circuit, whose output clutter power has a minimum value, is proposed. Efficiency of clutter suppression is found for MARF with an optimal algorithm for computing the weight coefficients and a simple algorithm, in which the weight coefficients are determinated only from the estimation of the correlation coefficient.

articleTitle: On the feasibility of increasing the superconductive transition temperature in quantum wire nanotubes
publicationTitle: Proceedings, 6th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: The possibility of increasing the superconducting transition temperature (T/sub c/) by means of varying the Fermi-energy level (FEL) in quantum wires (QWR) is considered. It is shown that this can be realized if there is coincidence of the FEL with a quantum energy level in the QWR. Procedures for achieving such a coincidence in carbon nanotubes are proposed, first through adjustment of the FEL by means of varying the electrical field in the nanotube, and secondly by changes in the geometry and size of the nanotube itself. Some technological pathways to achieving FEL and quantum energy level coincidence are considered.

articleTitle: Features of synthesis of zirconium carbide from metal plasma of vacuum arc discharge
publicationTitle: Proceedings, 6th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: At present the intermetallic coating of Pt/sub 3/Zr is used widely as an anti-emissive coating. Zirconium carbide technology consists in preliminary forming a coating of zirconium carbide ZrC on a grid from a coaxial vacuum arc plasma source. The main of the requirements raised to this operation is first of all the technological effectiveness of coating with guaranteeing of necessary adhesion and roughness range of coating to be formed simultaneously. The next layer of platinum Pt is plated. Intermetallic coating Pt/sub 3/Zr is formed as a result of thermal annealing.

articleTitle: Experimental researches of spatial distribution of a field of the parametrical aerial reflected from cylindrical surfaces
publicationTitle: Proceedings, 6th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: In the paper the experimental results of spatial distribution of waves of difference frequency (WDF) reflected from cylindrical surfaces are submitted.

articleTitle: Specification of the theory of telecommunication system devices on the basis of field effect transistors
publicationTitle: Proceedings, 6th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: Specified here is the theory of functioning of analog devices of telecommunication systems on the basis of field effect transistors (FET), operating in amplifier mode (generators, mixers, power amplifier) and in controlled resistance mode (electronic keys and switchboards, compressors and expanders, dynamic range of levels, auto regulators).

articleTitle: Dynamic processes at shaping of films by method of deposition
publicationTitle: Proceedings, 6th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: The opportunity for the prediction of the structure of a film is considered at rapprochement of an evaporator and substrate on the basis of the assaying gas-dynamic functions of the change of vapor parameters in the thermo-vacuum evaporation of materials.

articleTitle: 2002 6th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering. Proceedings. Vol.1 (Cat. No. 02EX546)
publicationTitle: Proceedings, 6th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering
abstract: Presents the front cover of the proceedings record.
